newsitem.title: GERMANY: German prosecutors say xenophobia behind arson.
newsitem.headline: German prosecutors say xenophobia behind arson.

text.p: German prosecutors said on Monday that two soldiers had admitted firebombing a building where Italian guest workers lived because they hated foreigners.

The army soldiers, 18 and 20 years old, were detained on Sunday after fire badly damaged the building in Dresden early in the day before. They were charged with suspicion of arson and displaying outlawed propaganda materials.
No one was hurt in the blaze. A group of Italian workers who live in the building had gone on holiday a day before the attack, police said.
Authorities found swastikas daubed on the building and said witnesses reported that the suspected attackers had shouted Nazi slogans shortly after the fire started.
